about_the_game:
The MXR PRO is a 3D animation tool designed to empower creators with no-code high fidelity VFX tools for concerts, live events and kk. The PRO version has additional functionality from our base MXR tier with additional cluster rendering, nDisplay support, DLSS4 AI Acceleration, AJA and Blackmagic capture card support, PAK creation and import and many new and improved FX systems. Import Unreal Engine levels, animation sequences (Sequencer Cinematics), material instances, and Niagara systems.

Current industry standard tools are raster based, but MXR uses geometry and advanced 3D geometry, FX, simulations, shaders, and post processing. MXR is a generational leap forward for VJs, live visual designers, broadcast design and XR. Using LFOs and external data inputs such as Midi, OSC and DMX, creators can automate a variety of FX and parameters to create dynamic environments for use as audio reactive or interactive real-time visuals.

short_description: MXR PRO is a no-code environment for high fidelity VFX. MXR PRO is the enhanced version of MXR designed for venues, festivals and power users who create 3D animation and visuals for concerts, live events and virtual production. Enhanced features: DLSS4, import UE5 levels, cinematic, niagara systems
